title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 (Red Alert 2 and Yuri's Revenge - Static Recompilation)
description: Static recompilation of Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 / Yuri's Revenge (Westwood, 2000-01) to native C, with the remaster the engine never got: a D3D11 presenter, 720p to 4K, HD voxel units. Built on pcrecomp.
